title: ALMA Pinpoints a Strong Overdensity of U/LIRGs in the Massive Cluster XCS J2215 at z = 1.46
question: Are the submillimetre sources in the core of the z=1.46 cluster XCS J2215 cluster members, and what are their SFRs, gas content and dynamical masses, and are they affected by environment?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.25 mm, six-pointing mosaic) and Band 3 (single pointing)
data.arrays: Band 6: forty-two 12 m antennae; Band 3: thirty-nine 12 m antennae
data.sensitivity: Band 6 rms 48 uJy/beam at deepest point; Band 3 channel noise 0.3-0.8 mJy/beam at 50 km/s

what.value: Spectroscopic and photometric redshift catalogues of cluster members (H10, H09)

evidence.quote: the 25 spectroscopic members from H10, the 46 sources from H09 with photometric redshifts indicating possible cluster membership

what.value: Archival CO(2-1) detections for five further sources

evidence.quote: we match the remaining fainter continuum sources to the (cite: hayashi2017evolutionary) $^{12}$CO(2–1) catalog, finding five further matches: IDs 1, 5, 10, 13, 14.

what.value: Median rest-frame H-band mass-to-light ratio of ECDFS SMGs

evidence.quote: apply their median rest-frame $H$-band mass-to-light ratio to our sample

recipe.method: Aegean source finder on mosaic with local noise map, >4 sigma; negative map used for reliability
Targeted spectra extraction at known positions plus blind search in collapsed 300 km/s bins; Gaussian fits
key_parameters: bins of 300 km/s stepped by 100 km/s, >4 sigma

recipe.method: Fit template SEDs to 100-1250 um photometry, integrate 8-1000 um, Kennicutt relation
assumptions: sources at cluster redshift; Chabrier IMF

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosities, gas and dynamical masses
recipe.method: Solomon & Vanden Bout L'CO relation; Mgas with alpha_CO=1; Mdyn disk model with R=7 kpc
assumptions: alpha_CO=1 (4.36 as alternative), R=7 kpc, random-disk inclination, r21/10=0.84

evidence.quote: we detect 14 S/N $>$ 4.0$\sigma$ candidate sources from the Band 6 continuum map
we appear to be detecting a $\sim$ 7$\times$ overdensity of millimetre sources
we derive a rest-frame velocity dispersion of $\sigma=$ 1040$\pm$100 km s$^{-1}$
we estimate a median gas consumption timescale of 200$\pm$100 Myrs

not_stated_but_needed: Band 3 beam size and clean thresholds
Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Deblended SCUBA-2/Herschel flux values and SED template choice per source
Details of the CO(5-4)/CO(2-1) brightness ratio conversion
Aegean parameters beyond the 4 sigma threshold
Spectral binning used in Gaussian fitting
missing_for_reproduction: Cell/image size and Band 3 imaging details
score_reason: Public data and clear outline, but several imaging and SED fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data; numeric results such as source count, CO fluxes and line ratios are reproducible, though some settings are missing.
